title: Combined Stenographers’ (Grade ‘B’/Grade-‘I’) Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2019, 2020 and 2021
body_text: Based on the results of the written part for the year 2020 of the Combined Stenographers’ (Grade ‘B’/Grade-‘I’) Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2019, 2020 and 2021 held by the UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION in December, 2025 and evaluation of record of service in November 2026, the following are the category-wise lists of candidates, in order of merit, who have been recommended for inclusion in the Select List year 2020 of the Services mentioned below:- Category Service IV Private Secretary Grade of the Central Secretariat Stenographers’ Service. V Private Secretary Grade of the Stenographers’ Cadre of the Indian Foreign Service, Branch ‘B’. VI Private Secretary of the Armed Forces Headquarters Stenographers’ Service. VII Grade ‘B’/ Private Secretary Grade of the Railway Board Secretariat Stenographers’ Service. 2.             2.1     The number of vacancies reported together with the candidates recommended are as under:- Select List Year 2020 Category Community Vacancy Number of candidates recommended IV General 204 01 SC 79 Nil ST 51 Nil Total 334 {including 02 (01+01 backlog) PwBD-1, 02 backlog PwBD-2, 02 (01+01 backlog) PwBD-3 and 02 backlog PwBD-4&5} 01 {including   Nil PwBD-1, Nil  PwBD-2, Nil PwBD-3 and Nil PwBD-4&5} V General 17 02 SC 17 Nil ST 09 Nil Total 43 {including   01 PwBD-1, 01 backlog PwBD-3 and 01 PwBD 4 & 5} 02 {including  Nil PwBD-1, Nil PwBD-3 and  Nil PwBD-4&5} VI General 20 18 SC 05 04 ST 01 Nil Total 26 {including 02 (01+01 backlog) PwBD-3} 22 {including Nil PwBD-3} VII General 34 05 SC 08 Nil ST 05 Nil Total 47 {including 01 backlog PwBD-1} 05 {including  Nil PwBD-1} IX No candidate qualified in the written examination 2.2     The results of 18 candidates, i.e., 17 in Category-IV and 01 in Category-VI, as well as of other candidates of Category-IV who are applicants in various O.A.s, as detailed in para 3.0 below, have been kept in sealed cover. 3.0 Final Selection of the candidates under different categories shall be decided and results will be declared inter alia based on the guidelines issued by the Department of Personnel & Training vide O.M. No. 36012/16/2019-Estt (Res.) dated 12.04.2022 subject to the final outcome of the following court cases:- Civil Appeal No. 629 of 2022 (arising out of SLP (C) No. 30621/2011) in Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and connected matters (Jarnail Singh batch of cases); O.A. No. 3801 of 2025 in the matter of Mahaveer Prasad Gupta & Ors. Vs Union of India & Anr.; III. O.A. No. 3828 of 2025 in the matter of Som Dutt & Ors. Vs Union of India & Ors.; IV. O.A. No. 3863 of 2025 in the matter of Hemant Kumar & Ors. Vs Union of India & Ors.; and Any other cases in the connected matter. 4.0     The candidates may obtain information/clarification regarding their issue(s), if any, in relation to the Examination under reference from the Commission’s Call Centre (Tel. 011-40303444/24041001) from 09:00 AM to 08:00 PM. The result will also be available on the UPSC web site i.e. www.upsc.gov.in . The marks, cut-offs, etc. shall be made available on the website within fifteen days from the date of declaration of final results of the Combined Stenographers’ (Grade ‘B’/Grade-‘I’) Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2019, 2020 and 2021 for all the Select List Years.
